title: PromiseLedger
description: Append-only log of narrative promises (core-ontology-v3 §5). Convergence rule: no GO at chapter level if any promises are overdue.

promises.description: Append-only; do not delete or modify existing entries.

Priority.description: critical = overdue triggers RE-PLAN; high/medium = REVISE; low = log only.

opened_at.description: Unit ID (chapter/scene/beat) at which this promise was established.

opened_by.description: Agent ID that created this promise entry.

must_resolve_by.description: Unit ID by which this promise must be resolved. Overdue = past this unit without resolution.

resolved_at.description: Unit ID where resolution occurred (null if open).

resolved_by.description: Agent ID that committed the resolution.

acceptable_resolutions.description: Enumerated resolution strategies the Convergence Controller may accept.

convergence_note.description: FORCE-RESOLVE note if resolution was forced (logged for issue report).
